posts.name: Aayush Sinha
posts.cooked:
I took this course in the September 2024 term, and I’m retaking it this term—not in the January 2025 term. Will my previous marks carry over? I believe I just need to complete the OPPE and BPTs again, is that correct?

Thank you!

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
That is not how it works Aayush.

If you are repeating after two terms, you cannot repeat OPPE only, you might have paid full price during registration and enrolled in complete repeat of the course.

You have to complete all requirements, not just BPT and OPPE. You are at par with new students at the expectations from your side.

I am doing “repeat oppe alone” in this term. Upon logging into my VM, I noticed that all four BPTs were already completed by me in the previous term.
